summary: A mixed day with significant legal developments and regulatory compliance issues. BSE/NSE penalties on power companies and trademark law concerns dominate, alongside retail sector insights on consumer behavior shifts.

bullets.text: BSE, NSE impose Rs 59 lakh penalty on NTPC, SJVN, REC for non-compliance with stock exchange regulations.
Trademark law deficiencies undermine India's intellectual property protection; Basmati case highlights systemic gaps requiring reform.
Karnataka High Court rebukes police for hasty arrests; questions whether arrest procedures have become arbitrary and ineffective.
Retail leaders identify time, trust, and personalization as emerging consumer currencies shaping retail strategy through 2047.
Young, aspirational Indian consumers to drive fashion sector's next growth phase; brands must balance innovation with core identity.
